name: PlayTools
howToChoose: Read tools[].plain, name, category, what, and firstProject.
If the phrase mentions lullaby, hum, song, music, sound, or note, choose id tonejs.
If the phrase mentions pen, plot, plotter, or ink, choose id plotter.
If the phrase mentions 3d, sculpture, or scene, choose id three.
If the phrase mentions shader, pixel, or color, choose id glsl.
Otherwise choose the tool with the most overlapping words. If none overlap, choose id p5.
howToFirstSketch: Build an original first sketch. Do not copy or redraw an existing artwork. Tool: {name}. Plain name: {plain}. Category: {category}. First project: {firstProject}. Starter page: {starter}. License: {licenseNotes}. Visitor seed: {seed}. Phrase: {make}. Seed URL: {seedUrl}. Use the seed as the random seed. Do not send the seed to a server.

tools.name: p5.js
tools.what: A beginner-friendly JavaScript library for drawing, animation and interaction in the browser; the most used library on Art Blocks.
tools.firstProject: Draw 100 random lines from one seed; change the seed and see a new output. That is long-form generative art in miniature.
tools.licenseNotes: Starter sketches in this guide are original and are not an artist's project. Example: Fidenza #0, Tyler Hobbs, 2021. CC BY-NC 4.0 Do not reproduce that image.

tools.what: Gives an NFT its own smart-contract wallet that can hold assets and act.
tools.firstProject: Create a token-bound account for one test token and send it a second NFT, so the artwork 'owns' something.
tools.licenseNotes: No verified example image. Starter sketches in this guide are original and are not an artist's project.

tools.name: ERC-8004 trustless agents
tools.what: Draft registries for agent identity, reputation and validation.
tools.firstProject: Read the spec's identity registry section and sketch what an artwork-agent's registration file would say.
tools.licenseNotes: No verified example image. Starter sketches in this guide are original and are not an artist's project.

tools.name: ERC-8217 agent NFT identity bindings
tools.plain: Bind an agent to a token
tools.what: Draft protocol that binds ERC-8004 agents to NFTs in other collections.
tools.firstProject: Follow the spec's verification flow on paper for one artwork token bound to one agent ID.
tools.licenseNotes: No verified example image. Starter sketches in this guide are original and are not an artist's project.

tools.name: ERC-7160 multi-metadata
tools.what: Lets one ERC-721 token carry several metadata URIs, with one pinned as primary.
tools.firstProject: Give a test token two renderings (screen and plot) and let the owner pin which one shows.
tools.licenseNotes: No verified example image. Starter sketches in this guide are original and are not an artist's project.

tools.name: ABX (Art Blocks)
tools.what: Art Blocks' free, open-source (MIT) protocol and toolkit for putting digital objects on-chain, with a CLI, an agent skill and an SDK.
tools.firstProject: Deploy one code project to the Base Sepolia testnet with the ABX quickstart, using its dry run first.
tools.licenseNotes: No verified example image. Starter sketches in this guide are original and are not an artist's project.
